summary:
Constellation 上一季 EPS 大幅低於預期43%，營收6.07億美元，獲利受市況拖累。
• EPS 1.38 美元，遠低於預估2.43（-43.11%）。
• 營收6.07億美元（B級），季節性規模較低。
• 獲利大幅 miss 可能反映電價、避險或一次性因素。
• 本益比22.89，估值維持中性。
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：EPS 大幅低於預期逾四成，反映電力批發價格、避險認列或天候等因素造成的季度劇烈波動，需釐清是否含一次性項目。短期股價對獲利失望敏感，但 AI 資料中心電力需求的長線邏輯未變。中期關鍵在核電產能變現與 PPA 簽訂。追蹤指標：電價避險部位、核電容量因子、新 PPA 進度與全年 EPS 指引。建議結合下一季強勁表現，判讀本季為循環性低點。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢不明。；電力批發價格與避險組合波動劇烈。；獲利季度間落差大，可預測性偏低。

summary_en:
Constellation missed EPS by 43% with $6.07B revenue, as market conditions weighed on profit.
• EPS of $1.38 fell far short of the $2.43 estimate (-43.11%).
• Revenue of $6.07B reflected a seasonally lower scale.
• The large miss may reflect power prices, hedging, or one-off factors.
• P/E of 22.89 stays neutral.

ai_view_en:
Signal is soft: an EPS miss of over 40% reflects sharp quarterly volatility from wholesale power prices, hedge recognition, or weather; one-off items need clarification. Near-term the stock is sensitive to disappointment, but the long-term AI data-center power thesis is intact. Mid-term hinges on monetizing nuclear capacity and signing PPAs. Track hedge positions, nuclear capacity factors, new PPA progress, and full-year EPS guidance. With the following quarter's strength, read this quarter as a cyclical trough.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, leaving the trend unclear.; Wholesale power prices and hedge positions swing sharply.; Large quarterly earnings variance lowers predictability.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估大幅低43.11%，獲利顯著不及市場共識。
